column1: # Module 05 — git properly. Format: Text<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
What is a git commit? {{c1::A snapshot of ALL files + parent pointer(s) + message}} — never {{c2::a diff}}.
What is a git branch? {{c1::A movable sticky note on ONE commit}} — creating one copies nothing.
What is HEAD in git? {{c1::Where you're standing}} — committing moves that branch's note forward.
What is git's staging area (index)? {{c1::The loading dock: exactly what the next snapshot will contain}} (git add).
What do git diff and git diff --staged compare? {{c1::Working tree vs index}} · {{c2::index vs last commit}} — read --staged before every commit.
What makes a merge commit special? {{c1::TWO parents — it ties two histories together}}.
When does git merge fast-forward instead of merging? {{c1::When the target branch never diverged}} — the note slides forward, no new commit.
What does git rebase actually do? {{c1::REPLAYS your commits as new snapshots on top of the target}} — {{c2::new IDs; the originals live on in reflog}}.
What is the iron rebase rule? {{c1::Never rebase commits others already have}} — rewriting a shared graph breaks everyone downstream.
How do you undo a PUSHED bad commit? {{c1::git revert HASH}} — adds an anti-commit, rewrites nothing, always safe.
Which git undo tools REWRITE history (so are local-only)? {{c1::reset}} · {{c2::rebase}} · {{c3::commit --amend}}.
Git: everything's broken and you're lost — what is the first command? {{c1::git reflog}} — everywhere HEAD has been (~90 days).
Git: you staged the wrong file — how do you unstage it (restore family)? {{c1::git restore --staged FILE}}
What is git fetch vs git pull? fetch = {{c1::update your copy of the remote's graph, touch nothing of yours}}; pull = {{c2::fetch + merge (or rebase) into your branch}}.
Why do dev/brain/~/.claude have NO git remotes? {{c1::Estate law: doctrine/life material never leaves the machine}} — pre-push guards enforce it.
Why do the dev/brain repos keep .git OUTSIDE OneDrive? {{c1::Syncing thousands of tiny hash files corrupts/slows}} — files sync, history lives in .gitdirs.
What ate the atlas merge commit on 04/08/2026? {{c1::An every-5-min pull --rebase replayed the branch linearly mid-merge}} (ledger 108).
What one command reads a repo's whole shape? {{c1::git log --oneline --graph --all}}
What does git -C PATH do? {{c1::Runs git as if standing in PATH}} — how sessions operate many repos without cd.
What is git stash for? {{c1::Parking half-done work to get a clean tree}}; get it back with {{c2::git stash pop}}.
